name: Dubai Holding
via: Dubai ruler Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum's global investment holding company
note: AGBI (2026-05-12) and The Business Times/Bloomberg (2026-05-12) describe Dubai Holding as owned by the emirate's ruler, Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum. Parenting to government-of-dubai is by the ruler's office link, as with dubai-racing-club, not a filing.
